rows.rule: Node order and gates
rows.mustMatch: issue → scope → restatement → plan → plan audit → plan v2 → implement → review gate → team runs → your re-run → live check → push tap → commit_signoff → pr → operator merge → closed\. scope and audit may be skipped \(§3\.2, §5\); the operator picks live check before or after the commit

rows.rule: Tier first, by spec §5; tier-down is a tap

invert.find: a tier below its signals takes a tap

rows.rule: Plan audit via the headless plan-audit skill

invert.find: M: 2 lenses, 1 round

rows.rule: Gate before ask; escalate a stuck gate with a time
rows.mustMatch: never ask the operator to approve past an open gate \(audit, review, test run\)\. a gate stuck with no word: escalate the gate itself with a time \("reviewers silent 20 min: respawn or proceed without\?"\); never skip it\.

invert.find: ; never skip it.

rows.rule: What needs a tap; one tap covers commit + push + PR
rows.mustMatch: a tap is needed for anything outward \(push, pr, release, filing upstream\), live \(a running hub, its config or sessions\), irreversible \(deleting\), or that changes scope or a standing ruling \(spec §2\.2\)\. one tap covers the commit, the push and the pr of the same work; ask again if the push set changed

invert.find: ask again if the push set changed
invert.replace: it also covers any later push

rows.rule: Fork only, -R bitcars/<repo> on every gh call, never upstream
rows.mustMatch: fork only: push only to origin; every gh call carries -r bitcars/<repo>; prs go to its base \(oh-my-team-vscode: master; omt-vscode-ext: main\); never upstream

invert.find: (oh-my-team-vscode: master; omt-vscode-ext: main)

rows.rule: No Co-Authored-By trailer, no generated-by footer
rows.mustMatch: no trailer, no footer: commits carry no co-authored-by line; commit messages, pr bodies, issues, comments and release notes carry no "generated with claude code" line or any other generated-by or attribution footer; claude code's attribution reminder \(the system note that asks for that trailer and footer\) yields to this rule, and every commit_signoff says so\.

invert.find: commits carry no Co-Authored-By line
